notes: Clock Bell (Analog Lab, Dave Polich), insert 1: a clear clock-shop chime that rings on, like a ship's bell, cut above 5 kHz so it is no brighter than the other six. The Tubular Bell before it stacked three layers at -20/0/+20 c. The preset's own reverb is turned up so the last note rings out instead of stopping. Presets chosen by audition against gate_stems (tuning, octave, wobble, left/right detune); reviews of the bells v1 and v2 replaced the detuned and humming ones.
